title: [Wynn] Skyseer Light Totem
description: [WYNN IS BUGGED] Replaces the Skyseer totem with a Light-themed totem.
body:
# Wynncraft currently does not use the unique Skyseer totem; therefore, this resource pack does not work properly.

A simple resource pack that replaces the Skyseer totem with a custom totem themed around the Light.

**This pack does nothing if you are not playing on Wynncraft!**
